dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, what would you have done if you'd been me?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈwʌt wʊd juː hæv ˈdʌn ɪf juːd bɪn ˈmiː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Honestly? I would have told my boss right away.
dialogue.reading: ˈɑːnɪstli? aɪ wʊd hæv ˈtoʊld maɪ ˈbɔːs ˈraɪt əˈweɪ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I did. But first, I lost my temper with the T-shirt company on the phone.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈdɪd. bʌt ˈfɜːrst, aɪ ˈlɔːst maɪ ˈtɛmpər wɪð ðə ˈtiːʃɜːrt ˈkʌmpəni ɑːn ðə ˈfoʊn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Oh no. How did they react?
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ ˈnoʊ. ˈhaʊ dɪd ðeɪ riˈækt?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: They were very calm. In the end, they offered to take back half of the T-shirts.
dialogue.reading: ðeɪ wɜːr ˈvɛri ˈkɑːm. ɪn ði ˈɛnd, ðeɪ ˈɔːfərd tə ˈteɪk ˈbæk ˈhæf əv ðə ˈtiːʃɜːrts.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: See? If you hadn't called them, they wouldn't have offered that.
dialogue.reading: ˈsiː? ɪf juː ˈhædənt ˈkɔːld ðɛm, ðeɪ ˈwʊdənt hæv ˈɔːfərd ˈðæt.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: That's true. Have you ever made a mistake like this?
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈtruː. hæv juː ˈɛvər ˈmeɪd ə mɪˈsteɪk ˈlaɪk ˈðɪs?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Of course. Last year, I overslept and missed a very important exam.
dialogue.reading: əv ˈkɔːrs. ˈlæst ˈjɪr, aɪ ˌoʊvərˈslɛpt ənd ˈmɪst ə ˈvɛri ɪmˈpɔːrtənt ɪɡˈzæm.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I had stayed up until four in the morning studying. It was a risky plan. If I hadn't done that, I wouldn't have missed the exam.
dialogue.reading: aɪ hæd ˈsteɪd ˈʌp ənˈtɪl ˈfɔːr ɪn ðə ˈmɔːrnɪŋ ˈstʌdiɪŋ. ɪt wʌz ə ˈrɪski ˈplæn. ɪf aɪ ˈhædənt ˈdʌn ðæt, aɪ ˈwʊdənt hæv ˈmɪst ði ɪɡˈzæm.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: So what happened? Did they let you take it again?
dialogue.reading: soʊ ˈwʌt ˈhæpənd? dɪd ðeɪ ˈlɛt juː ˈteɪk ɪt əˈɡɛn?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, but I had to turn down a trip to Phuket with my friends to study for it!
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, bʌt aɪ ˈhæd tə ˈtɜːrn ˈdaʊn ə ˈtrɪp tə puːˈkɛt wɪð maɪ ˈfrɛndz tə ˈstʌdi fər ɪt!
